tagline: Enabling clinicians to Find, Fight and Follow disease to deliver better patient outcomes
hero_kpi_rationale: The company is strongly focused on innovation in diagnostic and theranostic oncology, with key development assets (LNTH-2501, MK-6240, NAV-4694) that represent future growth drivers. R&D is therefore the primary strategic driver.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: The elevated R&D rate reflects LNTH's commitment to developing new radiopharmaceuticals, particularly in oncology and neurodegenerative diseases.
kpis.signal: High R&D rate for a hybrid diagnostics/therapeutics model.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures to maintain and expand production capacity.
kpis.description: Capex declined in 2025 compared to 2024, likely due to post-acquisition stabilization and prioritization of operational spending. Confirmed in source: $36.1 million in capital expenditures in 2025.
kpis.signal: Marked reduction in capex following Life Molecular and Evergreen acquisitions.

kpis.name: Net Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow decreased in 2025, impacted by increased receivables and inventory related to newly acquired entities. Confirmed in source: $390.1 million in 2025 vs $544.8 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Decline linked to post-acquisition integration costs.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount allocated to repurchasing shares to create shareholder value.
kpis.description: LNTH significantly increased share repurchases in 2025, with $100M in 2024 and $300M in 2025 (including $100M under the 2024 Program and $200M under the 2025 Program). Confirmed in source.

kpis.name: Revolving Credit Facility
kpis.explanation: Amount available under a credit line to finance working capital needs.
kpis.description: In December 2024, LNTH expanded its credit facility from $350M to $750M to support its growth and integration strategy. Confirmed in source: amendment executed on December 19, 2024.

kpis.name: Convertible Notes
kpis.explanation: Fixed-rate debt that may be converted into shares.
kpis.description: Issued in December 2022, these 2.625% convertible notes mature in December 2027 and support the company's capital structure. Confirmed in source: $575.0 million issued on December 8, 2022.
kpis.signal: Long-term financing source at moderate cost.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.343 billion in the last fiscal year (FY2018).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.234 billion in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: MK-6240 Upfront Payment
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to acquire rights to the MK-6240 diagnostic asset.
kpis.description: LNTH paid $35.3M in February 2023 and $10M in May 2023 for MK-6240, an asset now in NDA stage. In Q2 2025, MK-6240 met its co-primary endpoints. NDA accepted in Q3 2025 with PDUFA target of August 13, 2026.
kpis.signal: Key investment in Alzheimer's disease diagnostics with accepted NDA.

kpis.name: Cumulative NAV-4694 Payments
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid to acquire rights to the NAV-4694 diagnostic asset and reduce future royalties.
kpis.description: LNTH paid $32.9M in June 2024 and $10M in August 2024 for NAV-4694. In May 2025, additional $10M payment to AstraZeneca to reduce future royalty obligations. Total cumulative: $52.9M.
kpis.signal: Strategic access to cardiac amyloidosis asset with reduced future obligations.

kpis.name: RELISTOR Milestone Received
kpis.explanation: Amount received upon achievement of a sales milestone on the divested asset RELISTOR.
kpis.description: In 2025, LNTH received $5M following achievement of a sales milestone on RELISTOR, an asset whose royalty rights were sold in August 2023 to Salix Pharmaceuticals for $98M upfront. Confirmed in source.
kpis.signal: Non-recurring revenue but indicative of post-divestiture performance in 2025.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to stringent regulations in the radiopharmaceutical field, particularly with the FDA. Changes in regulations or delays in approvals may impact the company.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The radiopharmaceutical market is competitive, with several key players. Competition may affect market share and pricing.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on technology for its products and services. Technological advances or technical issues may impact operations.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: As in any healthcare sector, there are risks of litigation related to product safety and efficacy.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed multiple acquisitions (Life Molecular, Evergreen), which may present integration challenges and affect operations.

risks.title: Research Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on research and development for its future products. Delays or failures in research may impact growth.

risks.title: Reputational Risks
risks.score_rationale: Safety issues, litigation, or research failures may damage the company's reputation and affect its ability to attract investments and customers.

ai_positioning.summary: Lantheus Holdings Inc. (LNTH) has no significant mentions related to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided 10-K document excerpts.
